name: spektr
description: Offline keyword and demand intelligence suite for Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Vendors the keyword-intelligence engine and adds modules for entity coverage, query fan-out, demand trend, AI-citation readiness, winnable-click bands, and branded output. Use when analysing keyword exports (Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Moz, Ubersuggest) for SEO, GEO, and AI-search strategy without external API calls.
